name: The Rothschild household at 2112 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_rothschild_mrs_m_m

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 2112 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 2112 Mrs. M. M. Rothschild & dr.; Jesse Rothschild.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 2112, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The five live-in staff and two children it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. Left off: Jeannie Rothschild (the eldest daughter in 1900; which daughter is the 1904 "& dr." is not known, so the daughters are named in that line's note); Maurice Rothschild (a grown son (given name hard to read) the 1904 Blue Book does not list at the house). The 1910 census (T624 roll 241, ED 166 and 167) was read for this card's children: the children it lists, and those the Blue Book lists at the number from 1890 to 1911, are on the card with the years each lived here, whether or not they were at home in 1904. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Mrs. M. M. Rothschild
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Rose Rothschild here as head, born April 1860, in Illinois, widowed (ED 40, sheet 15A, line 26, leaf n822).

born.note: The existing census transcription gives born April 1860. The year is carried into the age shown on this card.

portrait_research.note: An individual portrait has not yet been verified in the period portrait books and Glessner House Museum article archive searched for this project. Any figure shown is a reconstruction, not an attested likeness.

persons.name: Miss Rothschild
persons.note: The Blue Book prints '& dr.' after the household's name: an unmarried daughter at home, not named. 'Miss Rothschild' is the book's own form of address, not a recorded name. The 1900 census lists the unmarried daughter at home as Jeannie Rothschild (born November 1878 (the figures are hard to read), in Illinois, single; ED 40, sheet 15A, line 27, leaf n822). She is very likely the one the book means, but the book does not say.

persons.name: Monroe R. Rothschild
persons.note: Listed at 2112 under Mrs. M. M. Rothschild from 1897 to 1901. That they were a son of the house is read from the shared surname at the number; the Blue Book does not print the relationship. The 1910 census has her the mother of five children, all living (ED 167, sheet 7B, line 87, leaf n1462).

persons.name: Mamie F. Rothschild
persons.note: Listed at 2112 as Miss Mamie F. Rothschild in 1899 and 1901; married to Alfred S. Austrian, she is back in the house from the 1908 edition, and the 1910 census lists her there as the widow's daughter, married eight years, with her own daughter Margaret, 6 (ED 167, sheet 7B, lines 88-90; the given name is written as it reads, 'Maurice R.'). Where she lived in 1904 is not in the sources read.
